data.reason_zh: 摘要明确描述多轮递归闭环：改进模型成为批评者训练后继，满足对象、反馈与持续继承。

scope_support.feedback_quote: as a critic it compares them pairwise, turning its own judgments into a process-level reward.
scope_support.object_quote: The critic is periodically replaced by the current policy, which closes the recursive loop.
scope_support.persistence_quote: each improved model becomes the critic that trains its successor, so the training signal improves along with the model.
